children: Zymeworks announced multiple material agreements tied to its merger closing, including a $350 million senior secured note financing and a Contingent Value Rights (CVR) Agreement linked to ampreloxetine. The notes, purchased by OCM IP Healthcare Portfolio and carrying an 8.25% fixed rate to December 31, 2036, fund a portion of the cash consideration and CVR-related payments. The CVR grants holders 80% of net license proceeds within 10 years, a $50 million first commercial sale milestone in key markets, and 10% of net sales for a period tied to market exclusivity. A Guaranty and Security Agreement provides a first-priority lien over substantially all personal property assets of specified subsidiaries to secure the notes.
Agreement 1: Zymeworks Sets CVR: 80% License Proceeds, $50M Milestone and 10% Net Sales on Ampreloxetine
: Contingent Value Rights Agreement linked to ampreloxetine
: Computershare and Computershare Trust Company, as Rights Agent
: License window 10 years; sales tail to later of 10 years/LOE/patent expiry
: Provide additional merger consideration tied to asset outcomes
Agreement 2: Zymeworks Raises $350 Million in 8.25% Senior Secured Notes to Fund Merger, CVR
: Senior secured note purchase agreement ($350 million, 8.25% fixed)
: Finance merger consideration and CVR obligations
Agreement 3: Zymeworks Grants First-Priority Lien Under Guaranty to Secure $350 Million Notes
: Guaranty and Security Agreement granting first-priority lien
: U.S. Bank Trust Company, as Agent
: Secure obligations under the senior secured notes
